For a successful call returning a streaming body, `sentry_patched_make_api_call` unconditionally calls `_finish_span(span)` after instrumenting the body. When that body is later consumed or closed, its wrapper calls `_finish_span(span, error)` again on the same client span; the wrapper’s `finished` guard does not cover the earlier finish in `_make_api_call`.
YES
